candidates.tagline: A $1,800 foldable that wobbles — so one owner got a razor blade
candidates.story: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8's camera bump is so large the phone rocks on any flat surface; one owner's fix was to razor off the entire camera module so it would lie still on a desk.
candidates.why_funny: Someone spent $1,800 on a flagship foldable phone and solved its biggest design flaw with a $0.10 razor blade.
candidates.alt: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 standing folded in an inverted-V tent position on a wooden outdoor table, showing the large camera bump on the back that prevents it lying flat

candidates.tagline: Apple's 'affordable' Mac mini now starts at $899 — for 256 GB
candidates.story: Apple raised the Mac mini's starting price 50% over two years to $899 for a base 256 GB model; the 1 TB storage upgrade costs $500 more — itself exceeding the machine's original asking price.
candidates.why_funny: The whole pitch of the Mac mini was 'cheapest Mac ever' — it now costs more than many laptops, and the storage bump costs more than a second Mac mini used to.
candidates.alt: Apple Mac mini viewed from the front against an orange-to-yellow gradient, showing its compact aluminum enclosure with two USB-C ports and power indicator
